scenes.narration: Being able to easily view your setlist is a core function of the My Church Resource App.
Serving days are marked with your teams color. Tap the date you are playing.
The songs, charts, and Practice Hub are located here. From here you can access charts or the practice playlist to listen throughout the week.
To listen to the Tracks MP3, open that tab. You can skip straight to your song by clicking the song marker you want.
Don't forget to smash the Confirm I've Reviewed This Setlist button once you've done so. Your leader sees who has reviewed the set.
